@graph.description: GenoCrate Batch Genomic Profile: a specialization of RO-Crate for packaging genomic data submissions. All files are grouped by artifact type, and artifact groups are linked to a single participant identifier, ensuring a clear, consistent structure for each data batch.
@graph.name: Genocrate Batch Profile
Hierarchy Overview
@graph.description: Data hierarchy: Root Dataset → Dataset → Collection → File. Each level references its children using 'hasPart'. Constraints specify requirements for each entity type.

@graph.name: Root Dataset Requirement
@graph.description: The root Dataset MUST use 'hasPart' to reference at least one 'Dataset' entity, as described by '#unique-dataset-rule'.

@graph.name: Identifier Dataset Requirement
@graph.description: Each Dataset MUST include an 'identifier' property for uniqueness, and MUST reference at least one 'Collection' entity (see '#artifact-collection-rule').

@graph.name: Artifact Collection Requirement
@graph.description: An artifact 'Collection' groups related artifacts and MUST reference one or more 'File' entities within the same category. Example: a VCF file and its index file form a single artifact collection. Assign '@id' using the identifier and artifact type (e.g., 'A001-vcf') for consistency.

@graph.name: File Requirement
@graph.description: Each file entity MUST have '@type': 'File'. Listing in the 'hasPart' property of its parent artifact is context-dependent.

@graph.name: Use BAG IT format
@graph.description: The submission SHOULD follow the BagIt specification for reliable packaging and transfer.
